a_p1: It was a long journey as they crossed the lands on the way to Gaul.
a_p2: The one fortunate thing they had in their favor was that, as this was a larger expedition, they had more men on their side in case of an attack, which of course happened during the trip with Heartless and the United Empire soldiers, and they had supplies that would last them throughout the trip. There was also a camp prepared for them when they arrived in the region.
a_p3: of course was taking charge on horseback while the Chaldea group were right behind her and she was currently having a conversation with

a_p5: He smiled and held the Keyblade out for her to take. She reached out and took the weapon from him, surprised by how light it felt.
a_p6: She felt her head throbbing and even heard what sounded like a silent hissing sound in her ear, but they both disappeared. She looked it all over and even did some practice swings with it. Much to her surprise, it disappeared and reappeared back in Sora’s hand.
a_d9: Sora : The Keyblade is a weapon that always goes back to their wielder.
a_d10: Sora : The Keyblade only chooses those that have a strong heart. But once it chooses you, the Heartless will keep coming after you to take your heart. But honestly, they’re afraid of the Keyblade because they know it can destroy them.
a_p7: While Nero was musing in thought over what she learned about the Keyblade, leaving Sora to his own thoughts as they traveled through the forests. During their journey to Gaul, they found out that the faction over there was led by
a_p7b: . Sora couldn’t help but feel happy. He was going to see her again, and this time she won’t be corrupted. But would she even remember him or what she did in France when
a_p8: A sad look appeared on his face the more he thought about her. That night when they stayed at the palace, after he woke up to go to the bathroom, he read up the full story of Boudica’s history. Once he was finished, he now understood why she had such deep hatred towards Rome. Losing her husband, losing her country, getting tortured and humiliated everyday by Roman soldiers and being forced to watch as they were not only torturing her daughters but also raping them as well. He doesn’t blame her for reacting the way she did when they first met in France when she confused him as one of them. Rome had taken everything from her and she led a rebellion, killing any and all people that were of Roman blood. She spared no one, not even children. To her, they were nothing but Roman beasts that had to be put down. It showed how far gone she was in her anger and despair.
a_p9: And in the final battle against them, her rebellion lost, and she took her own life.
a_p10: But what made it so bad, was that this happened during Nero’s reign. It only made Sora wonder what Nero was doing during that time it happened. Because in all honesty, after knowing her these past several days, she wasn’t the type who would just conquer nations.

a_d12: Nero : I shall get a Keyblade as well!

a_d13: Ritsuka : Huh? You want to be a Keyblade wielder?

a_p12: While all of this happened, Nero couldn’t help but giggle at seeing the interaction between them. This was what she wanted ever since the appearance of the United Empire. She’s been trying her hardest to bring some light in Rome’s darkest hour, not wanting her people to worry about the United Empire invading their capital and fully taking over. But it’s been hard because not only did she have to worry about the United Empire, she also had to worry about the Heartless because they were attacking both parties. Then new allies and friends have come to join her in the battle to protect Rome and that small light that was her grew bigger and bigger thanks to them. It was nice to have so much positivity in the darkest time.
a_p13: The rest of the journey to Gaul was peaceful as there was not a single sign of the enemy faction nor the Heartless, no doubt because they were busy fighting each other. It was only a couple of hours later, so late in the afternoon that they finally made it to Gaul. The expedition force were quite happy and relieved that their journey was finally over. And they made it vocally clear by letting out victorious cheers. Those who were at the campsite, heard the cheers and were more than happy to see the expedition force.

b_p1: A couple of minutes after their arrival and setting things up, Nero stood up on a small cliff, bringing all eyes on her figure.
b_d1_note: She shouted, her voice quickly taking on a serious, yet empowering tone.
b_d2: Nero : All you soldiers who joined the expedition force. For all the efforts you’ve made for the sake of myself, my people and Rome, I thank you all for your efforts in fighting against the United Empire! From this point on, I–Emperor Nero Claudius shall lend my assistance to the expeditionary force!
b_d3: Nero : Regrettably, the territory of our vast and glorious empire has been divided. This is perhaps the most tragic war we’ve ever been in…us fighting against our own people. Our brothers, our countrymen and yes…even the former rulers who’ve come back from the Underworld. However! No matter what past emperors we face, the true Rome shall never yield to them!
b_d4: Nero : You stand here because you believe in our empire! You believe in the peace and prosperity that our empire brings to those who live in it! For that, we shall not lose this war! Victory to me, and to your beloved Rome!
b_p2: In response to her speech, the crowd of soldiers let out a loud roar of approval. The ones that had been traveling with Nero seemed to have their energy restored nearly instantly, and the ones that had been at the camp originally were fired up and ready to go.
b_p3: As for the Chaldea Trio, two of them were left temporarily stunned as she finished speaking, more than a little awed while the other one placed his hands behind his head and gave a knowing smile.
b_d6: Ritsuka : Wow. I knew she was very charismatic, but I wasn’t expecting that.
b_d6_note: Ritsuka remarked after a few seconds of silence.
b_d7: Mash : I know. Just listen to this crowd.
b_d7_note: Mash said, sharing her master’s amazement.
b_d8: Sora : Yup. That’s the power of a ruler.
b_d9: Romani : [It’s still hard to believe what she’ll become later on...]
b_d9_note: Dr. Roman paused in thought which made the trio flinch at the reminder of Nero’s history.
b_d10: Romani : [And to think the reason for her change is actually because of…]
b_d12: Romani : [Yup. Nope. Never mind, forget I said anything.]
b_d12_note: The doctor told the three teens.
b_p4: Sora looked up at the current emperor as she made her way down from the small cliff. After Dr. Roman told them to keep watch over Nero, Mash gave him a brief summary of her notorious history; he honestly couldn’t believe that this very same woman was responsible for so many terrible things she did during her reign. The Great Fire of Rome, oppressing religion, killing scores of Christians (Which very much explains Martha’s dark attitude when they mentioned Nero to her), dismantling the Roman Senate and prioritizing being an artist over being a ruler.
b_p5: All of that led to her being forced to secede due to an uprising and during her escape, she ended her own life.
b_d13_note: Sora thought, a sad look on his face before shaking his head.
b_d14: Sora : No. There’s no way she did all of that. It was the beast inside her. It had to be.
b_d15_note: Ritsuka whispered, lightly nudging his shoulder. He looked over to him and Mash, then watched as he pointed across the large crowd of people, his gaze following his finger.
c_p1: Standing out amongst the crowd as she walked out of a tent was a woman. She wore a white corset and similarly-coloured short jacket over her neck and shoulders, both with gold trimming. Around her waist was a red skirt, and strapped around that was a leather waist guard, which matched the leather straps around her upper legs and her boots. He could see her carrying a leather shield around her arm, but only caught the sheath of a sword just past it strapped to her waist. He noted her short red hair, which has a very small ponytail hanging from the back.
c_p2: A happy smile appeared on Sora’s face. He ran off to meet her with his friends following after him.
c_p3: Hearing her name being called, Boudica turned around to face the trio and blinked in confusion as one of them got close to her, looking very happy to see her.
c_d2: Sora : I can’t believe it! You’re really here!

But then, why is she getting a sense of familiarity from…her eyes widened slightly as she started to get brief flashes of him looking and talking to her while holding a large key. There was also a moment where he was looking at her with a gentle regretful expression with her having her hand on his cheek.

Pure massive, bulging muscles under stony pale skin covered in innumerable scars, which were in turn bound by what appeared to be iron straps criss-crossing over his body at various spots. Even around his face, bizarrely enough. Beyond that he wore only the most basic of plate mail over the lower half of his body and around his arms. What was unsettling about him was the large wide smile on his face.
c_d12_note: Nero said, gesturing over to her friends as they looked up at him with frozen expressions.
c_d13: Nero : I was just introducing Boudica to our allies.

c_d14_note: He greeted the giant man with an awkward wave.
c_p9: Spartacus continued to stare at him for just a moment, tilting his head from side to side, before doing the same for Ritsuka, who nervously gulped, and finally Mash. m_d23: Mash : It’s the place where the spirits of all those that the world sees as important go to when they pass.
m_d24: Sora : Caligula and Caesar, they were summoned here from the Throne by Lev to be his Servants.
m_d24_note: Sora continued, eyes narrowed in anger. He could practically feel Boudica growing uncomfortable as they continued the discussion.
m_p30: Caesar already revealed that he and the others were summoned by Lev and they literally revealed that they were from the future and what would happen to humanity, so they might as well be clear as they can be.
m_p31: Before Nero could ask more questions on this, Spartacus spoke up.
m_d25: Spartacus : The land’s freedom is close at hand. Two of the United Empire’s oppressors have been vanquished and we know their leader is at the capital. Now it’s time for us to prepare.
m_p32: Hearing this made the group nod in understanding.
m_d26: Nero : Umu. The battle is over, Gaul has been freed. Now, let us go back to the camp and rest. For tomorrow, we begin our journey back to the capital and plan our next move!
m_d26_note: Nero said, managing to bring a cheerful smile to her face as she pulled her emotions together.
m_p33: They smiled in return. Soon, they left the enemy camp and were making their way back to camp.
m_p34: Still, what Caesar said greatly troubled Nero.
m_p35: An emperor even older than Caesar was at the capital. But who could it be? There were certain figures that came to mind but none of them weren’t as well known as Caesar.
m_p37: Surely, he wasn’t summoned here too was he?
n_p1: A young boy with red hair stood on a cliffside overlooking the battlefield, watching the scene unfold.
n_d1: ??? : Wow. So that was the fifth emperor of Rome? She was powerful!
n_d1_note: His eyes were fixed on Emperor Nero before they turned to look at Sora, his curiosity increasing.
n_d2: ??? : And that guy with the weird key sword was strong too.
n_p2: He turned to look at the older gentleman who was busy smoking a cigarette.
n_d3: ??? : Thank you, teacher, for coming with me.
n_p3: The gentleman blew out a sigh, letting all the smoke out and grabbed the cigarette.
n_d4: ??? (2) : You’re not the kind of person who could be satisfied by looking from afar.
n_d4_note: He said, his eyes narrowed behind his glasses as he watched the group depart.
n_p4: His young student couldn’t help but let out a laugh.
n_d5: ??? : That’s right! Now, let’s go check things out!
n_p5: He heard something behind them and they saw those funny looking yellow eyed monsters appear.
n_d6_note: The gentleman said, fully turning around to face them, placing his cigarette back in his mouth.
n_d7: ??? : Aw, don’t worry, teacher! We can handle them!
n_d7_note: The red haired boy said with confidence as he took out his sword, grinning in excitement.
